name: Undertale: Unbalanced Sans AUs Battles
desc:
Game is developed by True Sans, Invaild, and sometimes Robo Noob. Vikt does not work on this game anymore due to lack of motivation.

[PLEASE TAKE SCREENSHOTS OF YOUR MONEY FROM TIME TO TIME, THIS GAME HAS DATA LOSS ISSUES] 

In this game, you can either collect coins, or just wait, to get money which is a currency that allows you to use stronger characters, and unlocks phases for ones you already have. 

Rarely(and I mean, RARELY), there are events, where you have to beat a boss to get a limited character.

This is a FFA game, so there is no such thing as "random killing" or "abusing characters"(unless a character is unintentionally overpowered). 

For all your social needs the comms server or the roblox group forums can be used for things such as suggesting, reporting, etc.

Credits to RobloxNoobDX for drawing the game's icon.(and pretty much making half of the game)
